mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Look up booking links using an itinerary ID with your own connected account. Requires your own connected Ignav account.

ignav_id.title: Ignav Id
ignav_id.description: Account-scoped itinerary ID from a recent fare search on your own connected Ignav account.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Look up booking links for one manually specified outbound flight.

adults.title: Adults
adults.description: Number of adult passengers; total passengers across all categories cannot exceed 9.

destination.title: Destination
destination.description: Arrival airport-level IATA code; must differ from origin.

departure_date.title: Departure Date
departure_date.description: Departure date in YYYY-MM-DD format; cannot be in the past.

infants_on_lap.title: Infants On Lap
infants_on_lap.description: Number of lap infants; cannot exceed the adult count.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Look up booking links for manually specified outbound and return flights.

adults.title: Adults
adults.description: Number of adult passengers; total passengers across all categories cannot exceed 9.

destination.title: Destination
destination.description: Arrival airport-level IATA code; must differ from origin.

return_date.title: Return Date
return_date.description: Return date in YYYY-MM-DD format; cannot be before departure_date.

departure_date.title: Departure Date
departure_date.description: Departure date in YYYY-MM-DD format; cannot be in the past.

infants_on_lap.title: Infants On Lap
infants_on_lap.description: Number of lap infants; cannot exceed the adult count.

lookup.description: Required lookup mode and its fields. Without your own connected Ignav account, choose manual_one_way or manual_round_trip. With your own connected account, prefer ignav_id from a recent search for an exact itinerary match.

limit.description: Maximum matching airports to return (1-20). This limits one complete response; it is not pagination.

query.description: Airport code, airport name, city, country, or common metro-style search text; at least 2 characters.

origin.description: Supported 3-letter departure airport or metro IATA code, such as SFO or LON.

max_stops.description: Maximum stops for this leg (0-2); omit to allow any number.

destination.description: Supported 3-letter arrival airport or metro IATA code, different from origin.

departure_date.description: Departure date in YYYY-MM-DD format; cannot be in the past.

latest_hour.description: Latest local departure hour, from 0 through 23.

earliest_hour.description: Earliest local departure hour, from 0 through 23.

arrival_latest_hour.description: Latest local arrival hour, from 0 through 23.

arrival_earliest_hour.description: Earliest local arrival hour, from 0 through 23.

departure_time_range.description: Optional local-hour bounds for this leg. Departure hours use the origin's local time and arrival hours use the destination's local time.

legs.description: One or two ordered trip legs in chronological date order. Use airport or supported metro IATA codes. Itinerary segments identify concrete airports.

adults.description: Number of adult passengers; total passengers across all categories cannot exceed 9.

market.description: Provider-supported ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 market controlling availability and currency.

max_price.description: Strict maximum total price in the selected market's currency.

infants_on_lap.description: Number of lap infants; cannot exceed the adult count.

airlines_exclude.description: Non-empty list of 2-character uppercase airline codes to exclude; cannot overlap airlines_include.

airlines_include.description: Non-empty list of 2-character uppercase airline codes to include exclusively; cannot overlap airlines_exclude.

min_checked_bags.description: Minimum number of included checked bags.

min_carry_on_bags.description: Minimum number of included carry-on bags.

allow_self_transfer.description: Allow identifiable self-transfers. False is a best-effort filter, not a guarantee of a protected through-ticket.
